standards.summaryText: Express ideas and develop understanding: revise understanding and expression of ideas by connecting new and prior knowledge and experiences; review, reread, discuss and reflect on oral, print and other media texts to explore, confirm or revise understanding; seek out and consider diverse ideas, opinions and experiences to develop and extend own ideas, opinions and experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express ideas and develop understanding: revise understanding and expression of ideas by connecting new and prior knowledge and experiences; review, reread, discuss and reflect on oral, print and other media texts to explore, confirm or revise understanding; seek out and consider diverse ideas, opinions and experiences to develop and extend own ideas, opinions and experiences
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express ideas and develop understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experiment with language and forms: discuss and respond to ways that forms of oral, print and other media texts enhance or constrain the development and communication of ideas, information and experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experiment with language and forms: discuss and respond to ways that forms of oral, print and other media texts enhance or constrain the development and communication of ideas, information and experiences
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experiment with language and forms.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Express preferences: pursue personal interest in specific genres by particular writers, artists, storytellers and filmmakers
standards.officialOutcomeText: Express preferences: pursue personal interest in specific genres by particular writers, artists, storytellers and filmmakers
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to express preferences.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Set goals: examine and reflect on own growth in effective use of language to revise and extend personal goals
standards.officialOutcomeText: Set goals: examine and reflect on own growth in effective use of language to revise and extend personal goals
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to set goals.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.1 Discover and Explore > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Consider the ideas of others: acknowledge the value of the ideas and opinions of others in exploring and extending personal interpretations and perspectives
standards.officialOutcomeText: Consider the ideas of others: acknowledge the value of the ideas and opinions of others in exploring and extending personal interpretations and perspectives
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to consider the ideas of others.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Combine ideas: exchange ideas and opinions to clarify understanding and to broaden personal perspectives
standards.officialOutcomeText: Combine ideas: exchange ideas and opinions to clarify understanding and to broaden personal perspectives
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to combine ideas.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Extend understanding: reconsider and revise initial understandings and responses in light of new ideas, information and feedback from others
standards.officialOutcomeText: Extend understanding: reconsider and revise initial understandings and responses in light of new ideas, information and feedback from others
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to extend understanding.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 1 > 1.2 Clarify and Extend > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use prior knowledge: use strategies to supplement and extend prior knowledge and experiences when interpreting new ideas and information; use knowledge of authors, forms and genres, developed during previous reading, to direct and extend reading experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use prior knowledge: use strategies to supplement and extend prior knowledge and experiences when interpreting new ideas and information; use knowledge of authors, forms and genres, developed during previous reading, to direct and extend reading experiences
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use prior knowledge.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use comprehension strategies: enhance understanding by paraphrasing main ideas and supporting details, and by rereading and discussing relevant passages; monitor understanding; skim, scan or read slowly and carefully, as appropriate, to enhance comprehension; take notes, make outlines and use such strategies as read, recite, review to comprehend and remember ideas and information
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use comprehension strategies: enhance understanding by paraphrasing main ideas and supporting details, and by rereading and discussing relevant passages; monitor understanding; skim, scan or read slowly and carefully, as appropriate, to enhance comprehension; take notes, make outlines and use such strategies as read, recite, review to comprehend and remember ideas and information
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use comprehension strategies.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use textual cues: identify and use visual and textual cues in reference materials, such as catalogues, databases, web sites, thesauri and writers' handbooks, to access information effectively and efficiently; identify and use structural features of a variety of oral, print and other media texts, such as newspapers, magazines, instruction booklets, advertisements and schedules, encountered in everyday life to access ideas and information and to read with purpose
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use textual cues: identify and use visual and textual cues in reference materials, such as catalogues, databases, web sites, thesauri and writers' handbooks, to access information effectively and efficiently; identify and use structural features of a variety of oral, print and other media texts, such as newspapers, magazines, instruction booklets, advertisements and schedules, encountered in everyday life to access ideas and information and to read with purpose
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use textual cues.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use phonics and structural analysis: choose and use strategies for word identification, vocabulary development and spelling that either build on specific strengths or address areas for improvement
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use phonics and structural analysis: choose and use strategies for word identification, vocabulary development and spelling that either build on specific strengths or address areas for improvement
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use phonics and structural analysis.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Use references: use a thesaurus to extend vocabulary and locate appropriate words that express particular aspects of meaning
standards.officialOutcomeText: Use references: use a thesaurus to extend vocabulary and locate appropriate words that express particular aspects of meaning
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to use references.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.1 Use Strategies and Cues > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as magazine articles, diaries, drama, poetry, Internet passages, fantasy, nonfiction, advertisements and photographs; write and represent narratives from other points of view; expect that there is more than one interpretation for oral, print and other media texts, and discuss other points of view; explain connections between own interpretation and information in texts, and infer how texts will influence others; make connections between biographical information about authors, illustrators, storytellers and filmmakers and their texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experience various texts: experience oral, print and other media texts from a variety of cultural traditions and genres, such as magazine articles, diaries, drama, poetry, Internet passages, fantasy, nonfiction, advertisements and photographs; write and represent narratives from other points of view; expect that there is more than one interpretation for oral, print and other media texts, and discuss other points of view; explain connections between own interpretation and information in texts, and infer how texts will influence others; make connections between biographical information about authors, illustrators, storytellers and filmmakers and their texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experience various texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Construct meaning from texts: interpret the choices and motives of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts, and examine how they relate to self and others; identify and describe characters' attributes and motivations, using evidence from the text and personal experiences; discuss various ways characters are developed and the reasons for and plausibility of character change; compare two similar oral, print or other media texts by considering the characters, plot, conflicts and main ideas
standards.officialOutcomeText: Construct meaning from texts: interpret the choices and motives of characters portrayed in oral, print and other media texts, and examine how they relate to self and others; identify and describe characters' attributes and motivations, using evidence from the text and personal experiences; discuss various ways characters are developed and the reasons for and plausibility of character change; compare two similar oral, print or other media texts by considering the characters, plot, conflicts and main ideas
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to construct meaning from texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as word choice, balance, camera angles, line and framing, communicate meaning and enhance effects in oral, print and other media texts; identify ways that characters can be developed, and discuss how character, plot and setting are interconnected and mutually supportive; identify and discuss how word choice and order, figurative language, plot, setting and character work together to create mood and tone
standards.officialOutcomeText: Appreciate the artistry of texts: discuss how techniques, such as word choice, balance, camera angles, line and framing, communicate meaning and enhance effects in oral, print and other media texts; identify ways that characters can be developed, and discuss how character, plot and setting are interconnected and mutually supportive; identify and discuss how word choice and order, figurative language, plot, setting and character work together to create mood and tone
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to appreciate the artistry of texts.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.2 Respond to Texts > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand forms and genres: discuss how the choice of form or genre of oral, print and other media texts is appropriate to purpose and audience; compare the usefulness of different types of media texts
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand forms and genres: discuss how the choice of form or genre of oral, print and other media texts is appropriate to purpose and audience; compare the usefulness of different types of media texts
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to understand forms and genres.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Understand techniques and elements: distinguish theme from topic or main idea in oral, print and other media texts; identify and explain characters' qualities and motivations, by considering their words and actions, their interactions with other characters and the author's or narrator's perspective; compare and contrast the different perspectives provided by first and third person narration; summarize the content of media texts, and discuss the choices made in planning and producing them
standards.officialOutcomeText: Understand techniques and elements: distinguish theme from topic or main idea in oral, print and other media texts; identify and explain characters' qualities and motivations, by considering their words and actions, their interactions with other characters and the author's or narrator's perspective; compare and contrast the different perspectives provided by first and third person narration; summarize the content of media texts, and discuss the choices made in planning and producing them
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to understand techniques and elements.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Experiment with language: identify creative uses of language and visuals in popular culture, such as commercials, rock videos and magazines; explain how imagery and figurative language, such as hyperbole, create tone and mood
standards.officialOutcomeText: Experiment with language: identify creative uses of language and visuals in popular culture, such as commercials, rock videos and magazines; explain how imagery and figurative language, such as hyperbole, create tone and mood
standards.curriculumFocus: Students develop English language arts abilities related to experiment with language.
standards.sourceLocator: LANENG_79 > ELA8 > General Outcome 2 > 2.3 Understand Forms, Elements and Techniques > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Generate ideas: create oral, print and other media texts related to issues encountered in texts and in own life
